name: Arise Vibe
shortDescription: A condominium in Si Sunthon, Thalang, and the first Phuket project of Chiang Mai developer Ornsirin Group.
description:
Arise Vibe is a condominium in Si Sunthon, Thalang, and the first Phuket project from Ornsirin Group, a Chiang Mai developer with more than 30 completed projects in northern Thailand. Agent listings show studio, one and two bedroom units.

Foreign buyers can hold units as freehold within the 49% foreign quota that applies to Thai condominiums. Completion is quoted as Q1 2027 by one agent and late 2026 by another, so confirm the handover date with us before you commit.

The starting price shown is the lowest advertised figure. Ask us on WhatsApp for the current price list and available units.
